name: INSULT ORDER ~Namaiki Nyanko no Kaida Menu~
original_name: インサルトオーダー ～生イキにゃん娘の快堕メニュー～
source:
There is a luxury nightclub with demi-human hostesses known as "Demi-Stage Cafe".
In the guise of a restaurant, the hostesses provide customers with sexual service.
Let's train the hostesses in your favorite ways with lewd orders in your hands.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ220246.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
有一家由亚人女招待接待客人的高级夜总会，名叫“Demi-Stage Cafe”。
这里表面上经营餐饮，女招待们却暗中向顾客提供性服务。
用手中的淫猥指令，按照自己的喜好调教她们吧。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ220246.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
